versions.rationale: One patch for the executable extraction correction; no pre-existing bump.

findingsCorrected.problem: The unified-log grep required an unpadded [jit,compilation] tag. A longer tag already emitted to the same output pads subsequent jit labels, so the example can produce an empty result despite real tier-4 records.
findingsCorrected.evidence: OpenJDK 25.0.3+9 logFileStreamOutput.cpp and actual same-build JIT-only/mixed class-loader captures. Old command matched 5/5 in JIT-only and 0/5 in mixed; corrected command matched 5/5 in both.
findingsCorrected.change: Allow trailing spaces inside the exact jit,compilation decoration; preserve five flag positions and tier-4 constraint.
findingsCorrected.consequence: Prevents an extraction false negative being misread as absence of compilation.

findingsCorrected.problem: The extraction's decoration assumptions were implicit.
findingsCorrected.change: Explain per-output width growth and the earlier-decoration assumption, using a real mixed-tag example and versioned source. Different decorator layouts still require separate validation.
findingsCorrected.consequence: The command's demonstrated coverage is explicit without creating a universal log parser.

investigatedAndPreserved.suspicion: An unknown CompileCommand might be accepted while merely warning.
investigatedAndPreserved.result: Refuted on the examined runtime: unrecognized frobnicate option prevented JVM startup with exit 1. No edit.

Existing attempt-versus-installation distinction, compiler/mode-specific verdicts, filtered JFR coverage, nested/task identity, directive precedence/lifecycle and non-causal performance cautions are adequate for reviewed decisions and were retained.

capabilitiesPreserved: Structural PrintCompilation parsing with fixed flag positions, optional tier column, native wrappers, OSR and status records.
Attempt headers distinguished from successful installation; incomplete captures remain unresolved; codelist snapshot limits.
C1/C2 and runtime/compiler-mode distinctions, huge-method/version caveats, independent size/profile/depth/legality gates.
Scoped compiler controls, descriptor-prefix and alternatives matching, live directive lifecycle, precedence and safe cleanup.
JFR event names, fields, thresholds, inlining attempt context and bounded LogCompilation/JITWatch guidance.
Evidence of material workload cost before changing code/global limits; no compulsory tuning or rewritten worker workflow.
Existing plain-output extraction and legitimate unpadded unified output remain supported.
